children: Overview
Switzerland engineering group's 9-month sales and orders held near prior-year levels
Company says demand stabilised, with non-agriculture segments offsetting weaker farm equipment
Cost-saving measures continued amid low capacity utilisation at some production sites
Outlook
Bucher expects 2026 group sales to be slightly lower on a comparable basis
Company sees 2026 operating profit margin below prior-year level, excluding 2025 property sale gain
Result Drivers
NON-AGRICULTURE SEGMENTS - Co said demand was stabilised mainly by segments outside agriculture
COST-SAVING MEASURES - Co continued cost-saving efforts at sites with low capacity utilisation
HYDRAULICS DEMAND - Increased demand for hydraulic solutions, especially for construction machinery and mobile electric drive technology
